CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR  -3-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:12969  CRL.P No. 101252 of 2024  ORAL ORDER

The petition is filed by accused Nos.1 to 6 praying to quash the FIR and complaint registered in Chikkodi Police Station Crime No.20/2024 registered for offences punishable under Section 498-A of IPC.
2. Respondent No.2 filed complaint and the same came to be registered against the petitioners for offences under Section 498-A of IPC.
The said FIR and complaint are sought to be quashed in the present petition.
3. The petitioner Nos.1 to 6 and respondent No.2 are present.

The memorandum of compromise petition under Section 320(2) r/w Section 482 of Cr.P.C and Section 528 of BNSS is filed and it is signed by petitioner Nos.1 to 6 and respondent No.2 and their respective counsels.
4. The terms of compromise are stated in para No.6 of the said compromise petition.
As per the terms of the compromise, the petitioner No.1 has to pay a sum of Rs.20,00,000/- towards the full and final settlement of NC: 2024:KHC-D:12969 permanent alimony.

The petitioner No.1 has handed over the cheque for a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- the details which are mentioned in para No.6(d)
and respondent No.2 reports receipt of the same.
Out of the balance amount, Rs.5,00,000/- has to be paid at the time of filing of divorce petition and Rs.10,00,000/- at the time of leading evidence of divorce petition.
5. The respondent No.2 is present before the Court and admits the terms of the compromise.
He further submit that there is no force or coercion of anybody to enter into compromise.
In view of the compromise, the proceedings against the petitioners in Crime No.20/2024 of Chikkodi Police Station are quashed.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.

Sd/-
(SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR) JUDGE PJ CT:
